extraction_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. EDIT this existing pixel-art banner. Remove the entire gray-and-white checkerboard background and make those pixels actually TRANSPARENT (PNG RGBA alpha=0), including any checkerboard visible through tears or between tassels. The checkerboard is an unwanted painted background; it must NOT remain in the output. Preserve the entire purple and gold banner and its white sword and laurel emblem exactly, including its shape, colors, pixelated edges, original composition and scale. Do NOT remove the white sword or white leaves; they are opaque foreground embroidery. No redesign. Output the isolated banner as a genuine transparent-background PNG cutout, no checkerboard pattern, no background color, no shadows outside the banner.

variants.name: flag
variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one Space Station 14 imperial banner sprite. Two recent input images: the USER UPLOADED SMALL BLACK IMAGE with a WHITE emblem is the authoritative EMBLEM REFERENCE; the comparison sheet of six purple banners is the BANNER EDIT TARGET reference. Replace the sun/compass motif with the user's emblem: a simple straight upright silver-white sword/blade with a small crossguard near its lower end, embraced by two symmetric silver-white laurel branches, joined at bottom, open at top. Match the uploaded emblem closely. Three to four broad separated leaf clusters on each branch; bold central blade. The emblem must read as a white sword inside an open laurel wreath, NOT a sun, wheel, compass or circular ring. Keep purple cloth and gold trim. Emblem only is ivory/silver white with a single grey shadow shade. It should occupy a large clean central field with no cloth detail interfering. True transparent RGBA background, no black background, no text. Exactly ONE full banner centered on a square canvas, no contact sheet. Deliberate low resolution game pixel art: design on a STRICT 32 x 32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID then enlarge using nearest neighbor. Each logical pixel is one solid square, zero tiny details or subpixel texture. Cloth occupies x=4..27, y=3..29 approximately. Wreath+sword symbol should span about 13 logical pixels wide and 15 logical pixels high, with clear purple negative-space gaps between blade and leaves. No anti-aliasing, gradients, lighting effects or photorealism. Preserve the selected banner's distinctive silhouette, palette, mounting style and character, changing its central heraldry. Edit the REGAL banner, second column of the comparison sheet: wide draped violet cloth, top edge sags gently between two gold corner fixings, scalloped bottom, gold edging.
